senses.gloss: (cmp. אוּץ), perf. a. part. חָץ [to squeeze in; to be wedged in,]

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 3:8">Makhsh. III, 8</cite> <he>בשביל שיָחוּצוּ</he> that they may become tight (by swelling).

<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 10:3">Mikv. X, 3</cite> <he>בזמן שהיא חוֹצָה</he> (cmp. part. fem. <cite ref="H00334"><he>חוֹלָה</he></cite>, fr. <cite ref="H00319"><he>חוּל</he></cite>) if it is tight (immovable).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 3:1:8">Y. Ḥag. III, 79ᵃ</cite> top (<he>חָצִין</he>) <he>חָצִים אותה</he> they tie it watertight.

senses.gloss: חוּץ or הָצַץ to wedge in, form a partition; to intervene, esp. (at bathing) to prevent the water from touching the body.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 3:1">Erub. III, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Eruvin 27a:9">27ᵃ</cite>) <he>יכול לָחוּץ</he> (<he>לָחוֹץ</he>) <he>ולאכול</he> Ms. M. (Bab. ed. <he>לח׳ ולילך וכ׳</he>, Mish. <he>לילך לח׳ ולאכ׳</he>, Y. ed. <he>לח׳ ולוכל</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) he may form a partition (between himself and the uncleanness, by sitting in a vehicle &c.) and eat.

<cite ref="Zevachim 19a:16">Zeb. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>מהו שיָחוּץ</he> (<he>שתָּהוּץ</he>) does it form a partition between the body and the water (so as to make the immersion ineffective)?—Y. Sabb. VII, beg. 7ᵈ <he>שהן חָצִין וכ׳</he> for they form an interposition at bathing after menstruation. V. <cite ref="H01533"><he>חָצַץ</he></cite>.
